events.title: Fat Tony’s Boat Brunch at Irish Beach
events.venueName: Irish Beach / San Antonio boat departure
events.summary: A selected-Sunday high-summer boat brunch departing from San Antonio, with an Irish Beach pre-party, guest DJs, dancers, Fat Tony hosting, and three hours of house, disco and classic Ibiza energy at sea.
